About Us

From Assam’s Gardens to Your Cup

AmritGiri brings the joy of traditional Indian chai to your everyday moments. Made from carefully selected tea leaves, our Danedar Chai is crafted to offer a rich taste, refreshing aroma, and a comforting experience in every cup.
